title: AIT Student Academic Transcript (AitTranscriptCredential), schema v2, for transcript context v1
description: The AIT Student Academic Transcript as a W3C Verifiable Credential, Data Model 2.0, JSON-LD (ldp_vc), as the Issuer signs it with transcript context v1 (vc-lab/contexts/transcript/v1.json, served at {vdr}/contexts/transcript/v1.json). Under that context every credentialSubject claim is covered by the issuer signature: each claim is a top-level term and an untyped string, except courses, which is a JSON literal (@json) signed as one value. Changes from schema v1.1: Data Model 2.0 (validFrom, validUntil, credentialStatus), the context v1 URL in @context, and no embedded HTML course table claim. Every value is a string, numbers included, inside courses as well as outside it; dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) strings with no datatype. See ait-transcript-credential.v2.example.json, whose proof is illustrative and does not verify; the context and its rules are described in wiki/concepts/transcript-context.md.

@context.description: JSON-LD contexts: VCDM 2.0, then AIT transcript context v1 (terms under https://ait.example/transcript#), then the Ed25519Signature2020 suite context. Locally the context URL is http://host.docker.internal:9098/contexts/transcript/v1.json; a public deployment names the api. gateway instead. Only the path's version names which context the credential was signed with.

id.description: Credential identifier: https://ait.example/credential/ followed by a UUID.

issuer.description: The AIT University Registrar's DID (did:key in the demo; its public key is the DID itself).

validUntil.description: Expiry of this credential (UTC). The demo issuer sets two years after validFrom.

credentialStatus.description: The credential's revocation entry in Certify's Bitstring status list.

proof.description: Issuer signature over the credential, canonicalized with URDNA2015.

verificationMethod.description: Issuer DID URL of the signing key.

transcript.title: Transcript subject (the student and the degree)

id.description: The holder: the student's wallet key as a did:jwk (bound at issuance). Not a student number.

fullName.description: Student's full name as one string (not split into given, middle and family names), e.g. "Sila N Mahoot".

country.description: Student's country, as a name (not an ISO code), e.g. "Thailand".

registrationNo.description: AIT student number for this degree, e.g. "st125001". A student with two degrees has two numbers and two transcripts.

previousDegree.description: Previous degree and awarding institution, free text, e.g. "B.Eng Computer Engineering, Kasetsart University".

yearAwarded.description: Year the previous degree was awarded (YYYY).

dateAdmitted.description: Date admitted to AIT for this degree.

degreeAwarded.description: Degree name, e.g. "Master of Engineering", "Doctor of Philosophy".

faculty.description: School (faculty) name, e.g. "School of Engineering and Technology".

notes.description: Remarks on the transcript; "-" when there are none.

issueDate.description: Issue date printed on the transcript (the document's date, not the credential's validFrom).

courses.description: The course record, one entry per semester (term), in order. A JSON literal under context v1: signed as one value, so a change to any value inside it fails verification. Keys are plain ASCII and every value is a string.

courseList.description: Presentation only: one line per course, "<title> — <grade>", lines separated by \n. Derived from courses; what a wallet card and the PDF show.

programCommittee.description: Programme (thesis) committee members, one per line (lines separated by \n), chair first with "(Chair)".

cumGpa.description: Cumulative GPA at the end of this semester.
